verdict_reason: Trial-level Numerical_task.csv (8448 rows, 32 participants) plus Order.csv reproduce the table exactly (Distance F(1,29)=45.27, MSE=3574.895, n=31) once the stated filter AND correct-trials-only are applied; the audit script omits the correct==1 filter and gets F=42.58, MSE=3520.78.

data_files.notes: Trial level: participant, Notation (1-3), Distance (0/1/2), RT, Distraction, correct, filter_$. filter_$==1 for 3921 trials, matching the script's filter.
Replication's aggregated cell means (31 x 3 x 2); equals trial means over filter_$==1 & correct==1
Replication's SPSS GLM: NumerDiffere F=45.274, Error MS 3574.895, df 29
Audit's own result: Distance F(1,29)=42.58, MSE 3520.779

key_test.test: mixed ANOVA on per-cell mean RT: within Notation (3) x Distance (small/large), between Order (2); key effect = Distance main effect

statistic_reported.es: MSE = 3574.9 (no standardized effect size in table)

recompute.method: python recomputation (mixed-design distance effect via per-subject difference scores; checked against the SDV_RTs.sav aggregate)
recompute.result: With correct==1: F(1,29)=45.27, p=2.2e-7, MSE=3574.89 (exact match). Audit-script path without correct filter: F=42.33-42.58, MSE=3520.78.

obstacles: The audit script's filter is incomplete (no correct-trials restriction); following it literally gives F=42.6 not 45.3, so the 'truth' depends on which pipeline a judge trusts
Table effect size is an MSE and p is a floor (0.001), weak anchors for catching a planted error
N.R 32 but one participant (24) excluded in all analyses
